scope: Measured competition blocker diagnosis; no production detector changes

priority_order.blocker: Near-field boundary ambiguity plus unsupported far-field corridor produce persistent alarms and unusable nearest-hazard distance
priority_order.support_inspection: Frames 3,30,181 nearest components have respectively 302,364,319 points; zero core and zero nominal-overlap points; boundary points 28,42,80. Cross-section plotted from actual retained clouds. Semantic infrastructure interpretation is visual, not exhaustive labels.
priority_order.controlled_failure: Synthetic off-track case 126 at 200 m alarms at frames 7 and 8 as unsupported_nominal_envelope, despite known target outside the physical scene corridor.
priority_order.decision: Correct track-relative clearance estimation/uncertainty discrimination before infrastructure class suppression. Both near and far mechanisms must be addressed to change frame decisions. No safe suppression change established by this investigation.
priority_order.tradeoff: Tightening uncertainty or suppressing unsupported candidates may hide true boundary/far obstacles; do not tune against this nuisance recording alone.

priority_order.blocker: Sparse returns are discarded before temporal confirmation

reproduction.case_92_150m: Two target returns become one at segmentation height gate; remaining component rejected below_weak_min_voxels; no candidates in all ten frames.
reproduction.case_98_150m: Four returns become two; lower support 0.01194-0.01216 m above estimated railhead falls below min_running_height_m=0.015. Truncated target confirms in six frames but fails IoU.
reproduction.case_110_200m: One target return survives all point stages and is rejected below_weak_min_voxels in all ten frames.

priority_order.decision: Investigate joint segmentation-height and sparse component admission/confirmation, not weak_min_voxels alone. Single-point components also face cluster_min_extent_m=0.08; changing only weak_min_voxels cannot address that second gate.
priority_order.tradeoff: Admitting weak returns also admits infrastructure/noise; any implementation must preserve near-negative alarm behavior and fixed-index obstacle evidence.

priority_order.blocker: Evaluation contract and provenance obscure actual detection quality

evidence.real_annotation_provenance: One manual anchor, 35 detector-propagated labels, nonexhaustive, full-volume/support convention unspecified, path intersection unverified.
evidence.case_112_200m: All five target returns survive, target confirms 9/10 frames, IoU 0.00364-0.00921 because truth pads narrow support to 1 mm but prediction retains true measured width.
evidence.fp_metric_correction: fp_exhaustive_only is per-frame unmatched confirmed-object observations summed over frames, NOT event count. Historical narrative in results/panel-false-positive-anatomy-20260919.json is wrong on this definition.

priority_order.decision: Keep original scores unchanged; separate target-support detection, alarm output and localization evidence. Obtain independent on-track and exhaustive-negative labels before claiming field precision/recall.
priority_order.tradeoff: Correcting evaluation does not itself improve physical detection or justify box padding.

priority_order.blocker: Production input ceiling excludes 300 m and measured synthetic sampling has blind cases
priority_order.evidence: max_range_m=220; case130 target returns removed at first range gate. At300 m 4/12 positive cases have no target returns in any frame; all12 fail production localization.
priority_order.decision: Do not sell a raised software ceiling as hardware range evidence. First recover supported 150-200 m targets.
priority_order.tradeoff: Larger range expands compute and uncertain clutter; some sparse/invisible cases remain regardless.

priority_order.blocker: Replay latency exceeds approximately100ms input period on this workstation
priority_order.decision: Optimize measured geometry and segmentation work, not ingestion-only speed. Geometry initialization37.9ms includes background20.4ms; candidate clustering32.0ms; motion25.7ms.
priority_order.tradeoff: Inclusive nested stage times must not be summed; diagnostic replay throughput includes artifact writes; timings are not i7-9700E/RTX4070 validation.

priority_order.blocker: Required Docker ROS2 end-to-end delivery remains unverified
priority_order.evidence: docker info found client29.2.1 but failed connecting /var/run/docker.sock; no daemon available.
priority_order.decision: Need actual target-compatible Docker/ROS2 replay evidence, not another static command audit.

limitations: No competition scoring weights or opponent results: cannot quantify first-place probability.
Synthetic scenes retain original indexed seeds but do not establish field accuracy.
Real replay is development data, not a blind holdout.
199/201 alarm occupancy is NOT independently measured false-positive rate because the recording lacks exhaustive negative labels.
No production thresholds, boxes, labels or detector source changed.
DeepSeek wrote two bounded data extraction scripts; Main reviewed, corrected a per-case frame-accounting omission, ran actual experiments and interpreted findings.
